tutorial.reserve: The reserve on the left is four fans of three cards; only the top of each fan is available. Start by picking one — its rank becomes the starting rank of all four foundations.
tutorial.foundation: There is one foundation per suit. Build up from the base rank, wrapping King round to Ace. Complete all four full circles to win.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. There is no redeal — one pass only.
tutorial.tableau: Four tableau columns. Build down by one in alternating colours, wrapping Ace round to King. Runs move as a unit.
tutorial.reserveOnly: The heart of the game is the empty column. **While any reserve card remains, an empty column can only be filled from the reserve.** An empty column is not a digging tool — it is the reserve's way out.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.
